name: Rope, Hempen (50 ft)
description: A coil of hempen rope. Has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

name: Torch
description: A torch burns for 1 hour, casting bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

name: Bedroll
description: A simple bedroll for sleeping outdoors.

name: Rations (1 day)
description: Dry food suitable for one day of travel.

name: Shortsword
description: Martial melee weapon. 1d6 piercing, Finesse, Light.

name: Rapier
description: Martial melee weapon. 1d8 piercing, Finesse.

name: Greatclub
description: Simple melee weapon. 1d8 bludgeoning, Two-Handed.

name: Longsword
description: Martial melee weapon. 1d8 slashing, Versatile (1d10).

name: Dagger
description: Simple melee weapon. 1d4 piercing, Finesse, Light, Thrown (range 20/60).

name: Longbow
description: Martial ranged weapon. 1d8 piercing, Heavy, Two-Handed, range 150/600.

name: Leather Armor
description: Light armor. AC 11 + Dex modifier.

name: Chain Mail
description: Heavy armor. AC 16; Strength 13 required; disadvantage on Stealth.

name: Shield
description: Wielded in one hand. +2 bonus to AC.

name: Healer's Kit
description: Ten charges of bandages, salves, and splints. Spend one charge to stabilize a creature at 0 HP.

name: Thieves' Tools
description: Lockpicks and small tools for opening locks and disarming traps.

name: Arrows (20)
description: Twenty arrows for a shortbow or longbow.

name: Crossbow Bolts (20)
description: Twenty bolts for a crossbow.

name: Sling Bullets (20)
description: Twenty bullets for a sling.

name: Backpack
description: Holds up to 30 pounds of gear.

name: Pouch
description: A cloth or leather pouch holding up to 6 pounds of gear.

name: Sack
description: Holds up to 30 pounds of gear.

name: Chest
description: Holds up to 300 pounds of gear.
